title: Dimension-Free Private Mean Estimation is Impossible Without the Covariance
abstract: arXiv:2611.06615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the limits of differentially private Gaussian mean estimation when the covariance matrix is unknown. Prior work shows that when the covariance $\Sigma$ is known, the optimal sample complexity can depend only on its spectrum, rather than on the ambient dimension $d$. We establish new lower bounds for Gaussian mean estimation with Euclidean error which show that private estimators cannot achieve similar guarantees when the covariance is unknown. First, when the sample size $n$ is smaller than the effective dimension $\mathrm{trace}(\Sigma)/\|\Sigma\|_{\text{op}}$, the optimal error when the covariance is unknown can be larger than the optimal error when it is known by a factor of $\sqrt{d/n}$. translated_title: 没有协方差信息就无法实现与维度无关的私有均值估计
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当协方差矩阵未知时，差分隐私高斯均值估计的极限。先前的工作表明，当协方差 Σ 已知时，最优样本复杂度可以仅依赖于其谱，而非环境维度 d。我们针对采用欧氏误差的高斯均值估计建立了新的下界，证明当协方差未知时，私有估计器无法获得类似的保证。首先，当样本量 n 小于有效维度 trace(Σ)/||Σ||_op 时，协方差未知时的最优误差可能比协方差已知时的最优误差大 √(d/n) 倍。其次，当样本量大于有效维度时，即使对于有效维度不超过 log d 的对角协方差矩阵，协方差未知时的最优误差也可能大于协方差已知时的最优误差。
tldr: 该论文通过建立新的下界证明：在协方差矩阵未知的情况下，差分隐私高斯均值估计无法实现与维度无关的最优误差保证——当样本量低于有效维度时，误差会比协方差已知情形大 √(d/n) 倍，即使样本量更高时差距依然存在。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes new lower bounds proving that differentially private Gaussian mean estimation cannot achieve dimension-free optimal error guarantees without knowing the covariance, with the error exceeding the known-covariance case by a factor of √(d/n) when the sample size is below the effective dimension, and gaps persisting even beyond it.
